items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I had Abe Lincoln... And, he also played fluegal-horn. I had a wonderful bass player called Stillman... and, uh, I had Don Owens on the piano; I said Abe Lincoln, and myself-- it was a hell of a band.

ctx.x: to move to the West Coast and, of course, that was the worst thing I could have done; that's the one place I had a good offer to go out there and after I got there, it didn't last very long and, uh, first of all, they didn't want to pay any money and, uh, of course, I could understand why all those cafe owners out there -- you see, when the days when the jazz guys were working in the studios and in the theaters, you know, and the sound studios making movies; they were making good money doing that but when they…
